author: king process
description:
TOP 7 Old Factories in Korea That Are Still Running

Hello, this is King Process.
Today, we’ve put together a look at old factories in Korea that have stood in the same place for many years.
The machines may be old, and some of the working methods may feel like they belong to another time,
but real products are still being made inside these factories today.
These are factories that have kept running for decades,
and the people who continue to work in these places.
We’ll show you Korea’s old manufacturing sites, places that are not easy to see in everyday life,
through this TOP 7 collection.
Please enjoy watching.

1. The process of making candles by skilled craftsmen. candle mass production site

2. process of making billiard cues with delicate technology. Korean Billiards Cue Stick Master

3. Best Cauldron in Korea. Cauldron masters with 100 years of history

4. Old Pot Factory In Korea. Earthenware Mass Production Process

5. A golden bowl that has been around for a thousand years.
title: TOP 7 Old Factories in Korea That Are Still Running
